components.allowTrivial: The node has three levels from construction; the run is what makes any of them render.
The peak is read at the end of the run; the load-bearing half is that nothing called trackCaster, so only the node's own measurement can have raised it.
A cumulative count read at the end of the run; the sphere has to become a mover and then settle for it to reach 2.
The settle phase is what returns the sphere to static; at the baseline nothing has moved yet either.
A full redraw per moving frame would be hundreds of renders; the bound is what separates one region redraw per transition from that.
The mean scan time is a lifetime figure; the run is what gives it enough frames to be a mean.
